description: The pie chart illustrates the Token Routing Distribution in FedHLM, representing the proportion of tokens routed through different channels. The chart is divided into three slices, labeled as LOCAL, LLM, and EDGE_P2P, colored green, red, and blue, respectively. The LOCAL slice, colored green, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart, while the LLM slice, colored red, accounts for around 3.9%, and the EDGE_P2P slice, colored blue, makes up about 1.6%. The percentage values are directly labeled within the corresponding slices. The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The segments are arranged in descending order of their proportions, with the largest slice, LOCAL, being the most prominent.
